capabilities: Connect to 2-4 IMAP accounts and export selected folders for a chosen period
Generate a Markdown digest with a thread index, key contacts, and YAML message metadata
Mark potentially unanswered incoming messages after a configurable threshold
Save separate message notes with selected attachments stored alongside
Clean reply chains and signatures and run exports on a schedule via presets
disambiguation: Not a mail client; it only exports mail into Markdown and cannot send, edit, or delete messages.
extras: The plugin panel interface is in Russian while command names are English; until publication in the community directory only manual installation is documented. The README strongly warns to use app-passwords rather than the main account password and not to commit generated digests or settings files, since they can contain sensitive correspondence.
motivation: The author built it on the idea that an email should become a normal project source instead of sinking in the mailbox between ads, forwards, and corporate folklore.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull email in, so correspondence used as a source of project facts stays locked in the mailbox instead of becoming inspectable vault material.
summary: IMAP export plugin that pulls mail from selected folders into Markdown digests with thread metadata, unanswered-mail flags, and optional per-message notes.
